empty.title: YouTube video shadowing
empty.description: Paste a Chinese YouTube link (≤ 30 min) to fetch captions automatically, shadow along, and record locally for this session.
empty.tip1: Pick a video up to 30 minutes long with Chinese captions (manual captions work best).
empty.tip2: Wear headphones so your microphone captures your voice cleanly without video bleed.
empty.tip3: Recordings and pasted scripts stay in memory for this session only — no grading, nothing saved.

linkForm.invalidUrl: Invalid YouTube link. Paste a full YouTube video URL (for example youtu.be/… or youtube.com/watch?v=…).

tooLong.title: Video exceeds the 30-minute limit
tooLong.description: This video is {minutes} minutes long. Only videos up to 30 minutes are currently supported. Please try a shorter video.

status.tapToPlay: Tap ▶ on the video to start playback — your microphone is still recording.

hints.headphones: Wear headphones while shadowing so your mic does not pick up the video audio.

playerErrors.embedDisabled: This video does not allow embedded playback outside YouTube.
playerErrors.unavailable: This video does not exist, was removed, or is private.
playerErrors.generic: Could not load the YouTube player for this video.

recorderErrors.permissionDenied: Microphone access was denied. Allow microphone permission in your browser and try again.
recorderErrors.unsupported: This browser does not support audio recording (MediaRecorder). You can still listen and follow the script.
recorderErrors.recordingFailed: Could not record audio right now. Check your microphone and try again.

recordings.title: Recordings ({count})
recordings.empty: No recordings yet. Press Shadow to speak along and listen back.

changeVideoDialog.title: Switch YouTube video
changeVideoDialog.description: Paste another Chinese YouTube video link (≤ 30 min).

script.untimedBanner: Untimed script — use the buttons on the right to move through lines manually.

noScript.title: No Chinese captions found
noScript.noCaptionsDescription: You can still play the video here and paste a script manually to practice shadowing.
noScript.blockedDescription: YouTube temporarily declined the caption request from the server. You can retry or paste a script manually.
noScript.fetchFailedDescription: Could not reach YouTube or parse captions right now. You can retry or paste a script manually.
noScript.availableLanguages: Available caption languages on this video: {languages}.
noScript.guideTitle: How to copy a script from YouTube
noScript.guideSteps: On YouTube: open the video description → … More → Show transcript → copy and paste it here.
noScript.chatbotWarning: Do not ask a chatbot for a transcript using only the link — it may fabricate content. Only use tools that actually transcribe the audio.

manualDialog.title: Paste script manually
manualDialog.description: Supports one line per sentence, inline timestamps (01:23 text), or text copied directly from YouTube "Show transcript".
manualDialog.placeholder:
0:05
早上好，我是佳佳
0:10
今天我们一起练习中文…
manualDialog.untimedNotice: Fewer than 50% of lines have timestamps, so manual line stepping will be used.

dictationMode.untimedDisabledHint: Dictation requires a timed script so each sentence can be played individually.
dictationMode.inputPlaceholder: Type the Chinese characters you hear…
dictationMode.inputAria: Type Chinese dictation answer for the current line
dictationMode.lastSentenceSummary: Last line reached · Completed {attempted} / {total} lines · Avg {average}%.
